## Zone 1 — binding. ⛔ NOT re-adjudicable.

This is **Phase 1** of the maintainer's 2026-08-30T12:32Z ruling on **#11333** (option A, structured permissions as the only path, verbatim 「同意」). The ruling's reasoning, quoted:

> 两实现不一致时带治理的一侧(同意、审计、加宽拒绝 409 都在结构化侧)默认胜出——文档已叫作者『优先结构化』,而结构化在本地无读者

**1.1 — Scope is Phase 1 ONLY.** Wire `sys_package_installation.granted_permissions` (the install-consent set) into `PluginPermissionEnforcer` (F4) so it actually gates at **load time**. ⛔ Phase 2 — retiring the legacy `string[]` arm — is a **sibling card** carrying `Blocked-by:` this one. Do not touch it.

**1.2 — ⛔ `cloud` is NOT readable, and the card already forbids re-reading it.** The cloud-side facts (consent flow parses the structured four classes; `permissionsWiden` ⇒ 409; `plugin-consent.ts` says *"the environment runtime later feeds it to the framework's PluginPermissionEnforcer (F4) to gate the plugin at load time"*) are **在案读数** — recorded findings you inherit and ⛔ must not re-derive or contradict. This session's repo scope is `objectstack-ai/objectstack` + `objectstack-ai/objectui` only.

**1.3 — ⭐⭐ The gate must FAIL SAFE, and this is the whole risk of the card.** Installing enforcement where none ran means plugins that load today can start being **refused**. ⛔ A first-party / built-in plugin has no `sys_package_installation` row at all, and an existing third-party installation may carry an empty or absent grant set. **An absent grant set must NOT mean "deny everything"** — that would brick boot. Measure what the absent case must do and pin it in both directions. ⚠️ If the correct answer is not derivable from the ruling, that is STOP condition 2 — report, ⛔ do not choose.

**1.4 — ⛔ Do not weaken the existing pin.** `packages/core/src/plugin-loader.retired-fields.pin.test.ts` carries a positive control asserting the security barrel still publishes `PluginPermissionEnforcer`. It must keep passing.

---

## Zone 2 — PM mechanism assumptions. Measure these; ⭐ falsifying one is a reportable success.

**A2.1 — ⭐⭐ THE ONE THAT DECIDES WHETHER THIS CARD CAN LAND HERE AT ALL. "A production plugin-materialization site exists in this repo to wire into."** The enforcer registers a set the **cloud** control plane persists. My assumption is that this repo's plugin loader reaches a point where it materializes a third-party plugin and could construct a `SecurePluginContext` around it. **Falsifiable and quite possibly false**: if the only place that knows the granted set lives in cloud, Phase 1 has no local source to read and cannot land here as written. Find the site, or establish there isn't one — ⇒ STOP condition 1.

**A2.2 — "`buildPermissionsFromGrants` is the adapter, and it is already correct."** It is exported from the security barrel alongside the enforcer, which suggests it converts the persisted grant shape into `PluginPermissions`. Verify what it actually does on the pinned shape rather than trusting the name.

**A2.3 — "`registerGrantedPermissions` is the right entry point."** `granted-permissions.test.ts` already exercises it (`PluginPermissionEnforcer.registerGrantedPermissions`), so the primitive exists and is tested. Confirm the wiring needs no new primitive — if it does, say why.

**A2.4 — "Only service access matters for Phase 1."** Per the docs quote, `enforceNetworkRequest` / `enforceFileRead` / `enforceFileWrite` have no call sites and nothing patches global `fetch`. ⚠️ So wiring the load gate may make `{services, hooks}` real while `{network, fs}` stay declarative. **If so, say it loudly in the PR** — shipping a gate that enforces two of four declared classes while the docs imply four is exactly the declared≠enforced shape this repo exists to remove. ⛔ Do not silently widen to fix it; that is a bigger card.

---

## Zone 3 — advisory, not binding

- The liveness ledger (`packages/spec/liveness/manifest.json`) carries an authoritative note on this exact split, including *"nothing in this repo feeds the manifest declaration into it"*. ⚠️ If your change makes that note false, the ledger row needs updating in the same PR — a ledger that describes the previous world is worse than no ledger.
- ⛔ Never edit `content/docs/releases/`. If `content/docs/protocol/kernel/plugin-spec.mdx` becomes wrong because of your diff, correcting it **is** in scope — it is not release-owned.
- ⛔ Never `git stash`. Worktree-first before your first edit.

## STOP conditions

1. **A2.1 finds no production plugin-materialization site in this repo** ⇒ Phase 1 cannot land here as written. Report with what you found.
2. **Enforcement would refuse something that loads today** (absent/empty grant set, first-party plugins) and the ruling does not settle what the absent case means ⇒ report; ⛔ do not pick a default that silently denies.
3. **Your `git grep` re-confirmation contradicts my search-index measurement** ⇒ ⛔ STOP and report; the card returns to `pm:retriage`, per triage's own instruction. Do not build on a falsified premise.
4. **Any other open PR claims your paths.** Verify BEFORE your first edit. ⚠️ Three sibling seats are live: **#13657** (`packages/objectql` insert/update ↔ hook seam — conceptually adjacent to `enforceHookTrigger`, but a different package; flag it if you land in the same file), **#13576** (`packages/metadata-protocol` OCC ingress), **#13564** (`packages/drivers/driver-sql`, read-only). ⚠️ Note also that `packages/core/src/security/` recently received #13656 — check `git log` there before editing.

## Verification expected

The `git grep` re-confirmation with its own firing positive control; the A2.1 verdict (the wiring site, or its absence) stated first because everything depends on it; both-direction pins for 1.3 (granted surface enforced **and** the absent-grant case not denied); the full `packages/core` suite; an **ablation** proving the new gate's pins fail without it (mutation proved on disk by anchored greps both ways + changed blob hash; restore proved byte-identical to HEAD under a trap with absolute paths); the gate family from `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`; a changeset. ⭐ State explicitly which of the four permission classes your gate actually enforces (A2.4). ⛔ Report anything unmeasured as **NOT MEASURED**, never as a pass. ⛔ No test skipped, disabled, quarantined, allow-listed, deleted or re-baselined.

## 一、先说分诊那道强制测量的结果 —— 我的读数被更强的信道确认了

分诊要求「若复测与 #7500 的零矛盾 ⇒ 退 `pm:retriage`」。席位用 `git grep` 在 worktree 里复核:**与我的读数完全一致,零成立,STOP 3 不触发。**

⚠️ **但有一个必须记下来的信道校准,因为它下次会咬人:**

| 信道 | `PluginPermissionEnforcer` 命中 |
|:--|--:|
| GitHub 代码搜索索引(我) | **10** |
| `git grep`(席位) | **26** |

⭐ **索引少数了 16 处,约 62%。** 结论之所以没变,只是因为那 16 处**恰好全部落在同样的桶里**(定义 / 桶导出 / 测试 / 文档散文)—— **那是运气,不是方法。** 我在派发令 Zone 1 里写的「索引弱于 `git grep`,必须复核」这条,事后看是必需的而不是谨慎过头。⇒ 以后凡以「零」为前提的派发,索引读数只能当**线索**,不能当**读数**。

## 二、A2.1 判定:落点不存在(六条证据)

1. **两个 kernel 都只构造一个共享 `PluginContext`**,并把**同一个对象**交给每个插件的 `init()`(`packages/core/src/kernel.ts:91-171`,`:607` 的 `plugin.init(this.context)`;LiteKernel 见 `kernel-base.ts:75/202`)⇒ **没有任何按插件身份查找或包装的步骤**,`SecurePluginContext` 无处可挂。
2. 本仓 `sys_package_installation` 的 Zod 模式(`packages/spec/src/cloud/environment-package.zod.ts` 的 `EnvironmentPackageInstallationSchema`)**根本没有声明 `granted_permissions` 字段**。
3. ADR-0025 自己的状态行:*"Proposed — partially implemented … install flow (§3.5) … and install-time consent remain unimplemented."*
4. `verifyPluginArtifact` —— ADR-0025 说它在 materialize 时运行的那道签名校验 —— **模块外零调用点**。
5. `packages/cloud-connection` 的 `POST /install` 是**纯代理**,原样转发给 cloud 的 `install_package`,**本地什么都不 materialize**。
6. ⭐⭐ **决定性的那一条**:**ADR-0003(经 cloud ADR-0007 修订,2026-06-12)明文规定** `sys_package_installation` 是控制面的 desired state,*"**never read as what is actually installed on any runtime path** — runtime truth lives with the environment itself"*;而它点名的两个真实载体(env-local artifact cache / self-hosted 的 `LocalManifestSource` 账本)**今天都没有 grant 字段**(`InstalledManifestEntry` 逐行核过)。

⇒ **本卡字面要求的事(在 load 时读 `sys_package_installation.granted_permissions`)不是「还没实现」,是被一条 ADR 明确排除的读法。** 这个区别决定了它不能靠「多派一席」解决。

⭐ 席位拒绝自造落点(新的 artifact-cache 字段 / 新的按插件包装步骤 / 伪造的本地 grant 载体),理由是那等于**在派发中途从零设计 ADR-0025 缺失的安装管线**。判断正确 —— 那正是元判据「契约优先:在真正的生产者处修,不要在消费端造替身」要防的形状。

---

## 四棱镜

**① 实际业务需求 —— ⚠️ 比卡面看起来弱,而这是好消息。** 门要防的是**未受信的第三方插件代码**。但席位实测:**能加载那种代码的 `.osplugin` 管线本身没实现**(安装流、consent、registry 全部 unimplemented,`verifyPluginArtifact` 零调用)。⇒ **今天没有未受信插件在被加载**,这道门要保护的对象尚不存在。需求是**前瞻的,不是急性的** —— 等待的代价因此很低。

**② 项目长远合理性 —— ⭐ 强烈指向 cloud 侧(选项 B)。** ADR-0003 说得很死:该表**永不在运行时路径上被读**。在本仓建这条读法,等于**造出契约优先要消灭的那种分歧**:运行时本该收到一个**已编译的 artifact**,那么 grant 就该由 **artifact 契约**承载,而不是由运行时回头去读控制面的表。

**③ 防 AI 写错 —— 中等,但有一个尖锐的角度。** 一张写着「把 X 接到 Y」而**本地 X 与 Y 都不存在**的卡,恰恰是最容易诱使 agent**在消费端造一个替身然后宣布完成**的形状。这一席顶住了;⚠️ 换一席未必。⇒ **无论裁决怎么走,这张卡的措辞都该改**,否则它会一直是个陷阱。

**④ 创业期范围纪律 —— ⭐⭐ 最强,指向 B 或 C。** 选项 A(在 `packages/core` 建 materialize 缝 + 建本地 grant 载体)= **从零建 ADR-0025 缺失的安装管线**,未经设计评审、在一次 dev 派发中途完成。这是回答本问题**最贵**的方式。而配合 ①(今天没有未受信插件在加载),**等待几乎不花钱**。

---

## ⭐ 决定性的、我测不到的那一项

**cloud 侧编译出的 artifact,今天是否已经携带 granted 集合?**

- **若已携带** ⇒ objectstack 这边只差一个**消费者**,等 artifact 契约被命名后是小活;#11333 的 phase 切分基本成立,只是 Phase 1 的**落点写错了仓**。
- **若也没有** ⇒ Phase 1 是一个**跨两仓的设计任务**,那么该裁决的 phase 切分本身需要重看。

⛔ **`cloud` 与 `objectos` 不在本会话可读范围内**,这一项我测不到,如实标 **NOT MEASURED**。

**推荐:B**(先与您确认 #11333 的裁决是否真的意图让 objectstack 承担这段接线)。**C**(挂起等 ADR-0025 安装流落地)是诚实的退路。⛔ **不推荐 A** —— 它把一次 p1 的「接线」悄悄变成一次未评审的架构设计。

⚠️ 另请注意:这不是退 `pm:retriage`。分诊的路由(`domain:engine`、p1、落点 `plugin-permission-enforcer.ts`)**没有错**;错的是**卡所依据的裁决前提**,而那是维护者的地界。

**The granted-permissions set rides the plugin artifact contract.** cloud — the owner of the install-consent flow — compiles the consented structured set into the artifact/manifest carrier; objectstack consumes it from the environment-local carrier at materialize time. This resolves the STOP-1 fork recorded in the dev report (comment 5479869854): the missing piece was a cross-repo data channel, and per ADR-0003 (revised by cloud ADR-0007) the runtime-side carrier — not the control-plane table — is where the truth must live.

**#11333 Phase 1 is re-cut accordingly:**
- **Producer half → #14034** (`repo:cloud` seam card, named reader = cloud lane): first a measurement (does the compiled artifact already carry the granted set?), then the contract field + consent-compile write if absent.
- **Consumer half → this card**, now `pm:blocked` on #14034. When it unblocks, the dispatch premise changes: the local carrier exists and is named — the A2.1 "no local integration point" verdict is then discharged by construction.
- **The materialize seam** (per-plugin context construction) belongs to the ADR-0025 install-flow design work, ⛔ not to be improvised inside either half.
- #13458 (Phase 2) stays blocked behind this card — chain unchanged.
